title: create_pseudobulk
description:
Generation of pseudobulk samples from single-cell transcriptomics data,
by aggregating raw gene expression counts from individual cells to create 
bulk-like expression profiles suitable for differential expression analysis
with methods designed for bulk differential expression analysis.
Note that this componentonly considers factors as explanatory variables, 
and excludes covariates from the analysis.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['input.h5mu']`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

input_layer.description: Input layer to use. If None, X is used. This layer must contain raw counts.

obs_label.description: .obs field containing the variable to group on. Typically this field contains cell groups such as annotated cell types or clusters.

obs_groups.description: .obs fields containing the experimental condition(s) to create pseudobulk samples for.

aggregation_method.description: Method to aggregate the raw counts for pseudoreplicates. Either sum or mean.

obs_cell_count.description: The .obs field to store the number of observations per pseudobulk sample.

output.description: Output h5mu file containing the aggregated pseudobulk samples.
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

output_compression.description: The compression format to be used on the output h5mu object.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
